svg.title: P009 · Check how Active and Allowed are encoded
svg.desc: One row per source table and distinct raw flag value. Active 1 occurs twice, 0 once and NULL once. COUNT(*) includes the row whose flag is NULL. Start again from Payments. Y appears once and N twice. These three payment rows form two groups. Three Category groups plus two Payments groups give five output rows. Their counts add to seven input rows. The query permits any row order.
svg.text: Check how Active and Allowed are encoded
One row per source table and distinct raw flag value.
Will a NULL Active value form a group? Can the two flag summaries be stacked?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
Which raw values occur in Category?
Active 1 occurs twice, 0 once and NULL once. COUNT(*) includes the row whose flag is NULL.
Which raw values occur in Payments?
Start again from Payments. Y appears once and N twice. These three payment rows form two groups.
